# 2. Technical details


```{r}
# Import original data
listings <- read.csv("https://ajohns24.github.io/data/NYC_airbnb_kaggle.csv")
nbhd     <- read.csv("https://ajohns24.github.io/data/NYC_nbhd_kaggle.csv")

# Wrangle this into the final airbnb data
set.seed(253)
airbnb <- listings %>% 
  filter(price > 0, price < 1000) %>% 
  sample_n(size = 5000) %>% 
  rename(neighbourhood = neighbourhood_cleansed) %>% 
  left_join(nbhd) %>% 
  select(-neighbourhood, -amenities, -host_response_rate, -calendar_updated)
```

```{r}
# Data wrangling 
airbnb_model <- airbnb %>% 
  select(-id, -square_feet)
```


**Plots**

```{r}
# Plot 1: Price Distributions Across Neighborhood Groups (Boroughs)
ggplot(airbnb_model, aes(x = neighbourhood_group, y = price, fill = neighbourhood_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "AirBnB Price Distributions Across NYC Boroughs",
    x = "Borough",
    y = "Nightly Price ($)",
    caption = "Figure 1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d()
```

```{r}
# Plot 2: Predictors used (2): accommodation capacity, roomtype
ggplot(airbnb_model, aes(x = accommodates, y = price, color = room_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, position = "jitter") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Price Trends by Physical Capacity and Room Type",
    x = "Number of Guests Accommodated",
    y = "Nightly Price ($)",
    color = "Room Type",
    caption = "Figure 2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


> LASSO Model

```{r}
# Define model specification
airbnb_lasso_spec <- linear_reg() |> 
  set_mode("regression") |> 
  set_engine("glmnet") |> 
  set_args(mixture = 1, penalty = tune())

# Define recipe preprocessing steps
airbnb_variable_recipe <- recipe(price ~ ., data = airbnb_model) |> 
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) |> 
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5) |> 
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) 
```

```{r}
# Bundle into workflow
airbnb_lasso_workflow <- workflow() |> 
  add_recipe(airbnb_variable_recipe) |> 
  add_model(airbnb_lasso_spec)
```


```{r}
# Tune model over cross-validation grid
set.seed(253)
airbnb_lasso_models <- airbnb_lasso_workflow |> 
  tune_grid(
    grid = grid_regular(penalty(range = c(-3, 1)), levels = 50),
    resamples = vfold_cv(airbnb_model, v = 10),
    metrics = metric_set(mae)
  )
```


```{r}
# Plot cross-validation results
autoplot(airbnb_lasso_models) + 
  scale_x_continuous() + 
  xlab(expression(lambda))
```

```{r}
# Select optimal penalty parameter
best_penalty <- airbnb_lasso_models |> 
  select_best(metric = "mae")

best_penalty

parsimonious_penalty <- airbnb_lasso_models |> 
  select_by_one_std_err(metric = "mae", desc(penalty))

parsimonious_penalty

# Check MAE
show_best(airbnb_lasso_models, metric = "mae")

collect_metrics(airbnb_lasso_models) |> 
  filter(penalty == parsimonious_penalty$penalty)
```


```{r}
# Finalize workflow and fit full model
airbnb_final_lasso <- airbnb_lasso_workflow |> 
  finalize_workflow(parameters = parsimonious_penalty) |> 
  fit(data = airbnb_model)

# View non-zero coefficient estimates
airbnb_final_lasso %>%
  tidy() %>%
  filter(estimate != 0) %>% 
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate)))
```

```{r}
all_airbnb_lasso <- airbnb_final_lasso %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  pluck("fit")

plot(all_airbnb_lasso, xvar = "lambda", sign.lambda = 1, label = TRUE, col = rainbow(20)) 
```
